item.title: Feel good post
item.description: That was a scary run. I landed this job in June, thinking that it'd be able to last me long term and that I can deal with the downsides for the first bit... Welp, turns out the company hasn't been getting nearly as much business as they'd hoped so they're laying off tons of people across the country. I was one of them. I was rather devastated, it came out of nowhere, and I have been exceptionally concerned because I have family court coming up and my ex would just LOVE to hold THIS against me. Then big boss man called me up to tell me the news, and I'm back, baby! I'm not a fan of the shift, I was working 12:00-8:30 initially but now it's gonna be 2:00-10:30... But I have a job... It doesn't pay as much as I want, but I have a job... A lot of people don't, so I am not taking it for granted. I think I'm still gonna look for a new job, though... One that pays a living wage, and is more stable.

item.title: Being Internet Famous
item.description: AlsoAshley Dates the Internet… I have been posting these cause you all seem to love them (some of you too much, my DMs here on imager have blow up since starting this series...) Anyway, context before the comments inevitably do what they have on these posts: These videos start where the actual conversation started. The messages you see at the beginning are the first DMs these guys sent me... I'm not cutting out some earlier conversation that makes them make more sense. My dating profile also explicitly says that I'm trans and pre-op. They know. I promise, you do not need to accuse me of being the stereotype... I generally only turn conversations into videos when they eventually get weird, hostile, or the guy turns on me. Often I leave that part out because the interaction is funnier without it, or because I'd rather end on the joke than the ugliness. Obligatory wholesome disclaimer: All of the ad revenue from my YouTube channel goes to trans charities. So if you watch these idiots be idiots over there, they accidentally help trans people. Which remains one of my favorite parts of this entire project. I've also genuinely loved posting these because it's given me another way to connect with other trans folks over the shared absurdity of trying to date while trans. My Channel: https://youtube.com/shorts/4Ysv1XVPVMg

item.title: Thank you, mom
item.description: My soul cat, Thomas, was orange. His paw print is my tattoo. There will never be another cat like him. And I picked up these three orange boys last Friday. The next day was Dadurday, when I spend the day with my dad. It also happened to be the four year anniversary of my mom dying. I so very much wanted them to be able to handle going over to his house. But they were SO young and tiny. I didn’t know what was gonna happen. They fucking KILLED IT. Super playful, super affectionate, not scared in the least. One of them fell asleep on my dad’s arm. My dad was absolutely smitten with these kittens. I am convinced my mom sent me three Thomas’s to help ease the sting of her passing. Thank you, mom. You nailed it
